messages:
acme-customer: Hey @sarah-support — our team ran a bulk embeddings job last night (~120k tokens) and the API responses show x-consumed-tokens in headers, but our org balance didn't change. org: acme-inc, sample request id: r_5f1a8b3c

sarah-support: Sorry to hear that — can you paste one of the request ids + approx timestamp? Also which SDK/version?

acme-customer: sure: request_id=r_5f1a8b3c, ts=2026-11-02T01:23:45Z. Using node-sdk v1.4.2, concurrency=8, retries=exponential backoff, no idempotency key.

sarah-support: thx. Escalating to billing + eng. @mike-billing @raj-eng any quick thoughts?

mike-billing: checking ledger snapshots for acme-inc around that time — I see a finalize record for session svc-xyz but no debit entry applied. forwarding ingestor logs.

raj-eng: can you paste router + finalizer logs? this smells like a race where multiple batch workers hit finalize concurrently and one path skipped debit.

mike-billing: here's an anonymized snippet from ledger service logs:
```
INFO 2026-11-02T01:23:46Z finalize-session session_id=svc-xyz status=attempted
WARN 2026-11-02T01:23:46Z duplicate-finalize detected for session=svc-xyz, tx_id=null
INFO 2026-11-02T01:23:47Z finalize-complete session=svc-xyz result=skipped
```

acme-customer: that lines up — client got 200 and header `x-consumed-tokens: 120000`, but wallet shows unchanged balance in UI and billing API.

sarah-support: short-term mitigation: we can grant a one-time credit for the missing 120k tokens and mark this P1. @mike-billing can you apply and log the manual adj?

mike-billing: applied a credit of 120000 tokens to acme-inc and created billing ticket BILL-429. Note: we left an audit note referencing request_id r_5f1a8b3c.

raj-eng: root cause analysis so far: finalizer microservice had an idempotency gap — dedupe key was session_id-only and a race allowed a null tx_id branch to mark finalize as skipped before the commit path wrote the debit. PR #5234 adds a stronger dedupe key + DB constraint and retries the commit path.

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary rollout 4/10 nodes for PR #5234 — initiated by raj-eng — ETA ~12m.

acme-customer: thanks — we'll watch and confirm once the canary finishes.

sarah-support: follow-up plan: if you still see discrepancies after the patch, we'll perform a ledger reconciliation for that time range and apply any leftover manual adjustments. Eng will open a postmortem and schedule a test harness for concurrent finalize flows.

raj-eng: postmortem PR opened, includes repro steps and a small stress test that simulates 32 concurrent finalize requests. tagging product for potential UX/observability improvements.

acme-customer: confirmed balance updated in UI after the credit; everything looks normal now — thanks for the turnaround :tada:
